title: Defeat of Sardanapalus I (Ashur-danin-pal); first Median revolt
summary: The rebellion of Ashur-danin-pal, the original "Sardanapalus", against his father Shalmaneser III ends in his defeat, and the Medes revolt.
description: CFAH-5 anchor point AP-33. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-33: Defeat of Sardanapalus I—Ashur-danin-pal—First Median Revolt: 826–822 B.C."
chronologies.note: Ashur-danin-pal, son of Shalmaneser III, was defeated and presumably died in his father's last year, 823 B.C.
